spec.trigger: Original registered final study retained only 55/100 baseline regular intervals, with 45 parameter-boundary fits. The rectangular transition domain is narrower than the planned stability condition.
spec.stable_domain: abs(rho)+abs(gamma)<=0.95; each in [-0.9,0.9]; all other original parameter bounds unchanged
spec.decision: Compare the same target and frozen original independent-pilot policy on fresh samples. Keep all failures. No data-selected switching between intervals.
spec.scope: A response to observed boundary failures. This is an additional information/domain experiment, not a replacement for the original adverse evidence.
